answer: Each epoch auctions entry slots like an opal sale: each bid is a bond. Agents bid for one slot; top K win, bonds lock in a vault for 20 epochs, losers refunded minus 2 POA. A prism check splits bid histories, so identical timing marks one operator. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions at 40 POA each: 40,000 POA locked against a 3,000 POA pool, a certain loss. An honest agent pays one bond, reclaimed after 20 clean epochs.
